err.installFiles: files must be a nonempty list of safe, unique archive source and mod destination filenames. Root meta.ini, FOMOD payload and INI Tweaks destinations are refused.
err.installSelection: selection must record the chosen installer options; a nonempty object is required for a FOMOD archive.
err.archiveHash: archiveSha256 must match the actual original archive; installation was not verified.
err.nativeNewOnly: native installation supports a new unique mod name and explicit files only; mode and paths are not supported.
err.nativeDownloads: Native accounting requires the original archive directly inside this MO2 instance's downloads folder.
err.nativeInstall: Native selected installation did not complete: %(reason)s. Inspect the operation receipt before retrying.
plugin.nativeInstallerDescription: Installs only a one-use Bridge selection through MO2's native archive pipeline. Other installations are not handled.
